# Indian Philosophy — Articulation, Agency and the Sourceward Turn

## #0 — Appearing already carries the power of an account

An articulated world has functions, distinctions and forms which can themselves become objects of inquiry. Their source remains operative through that articulation. In [Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md), luminous appearing and its self-apprehending power belong together; [Vāk](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A06-Vak.md) follows their articulation into speech, and [the tattvic differential field](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) follows their contraction into finite worldhood. Appearing, speaking and acting acquire differentiated powers through this movement. The contemporary comparison asks how those powers make a situated agency answerable to the relation through which it acts.

The [Śaiva, Sāṃkhya, Buddhist, arithmetic and modern reception histories](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/indian-philosophy/DEVELOPMENT-indian-philosophy.md) give appearing, knowing, speaking, acting and recognising different temporal and doctrinal bodies. Their comparison retains the direction of [ontological dependence](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md):

**Subject/Consciousness → Mind/Objective Internality → Object.**

The order is ontological. An object available to explanation is already determinate within appearing; installing such an object as the producer of appearing reverses the dependency used by the explanation. Mind names the articulated middle through which objects become available. It has real structure and causal efficacy, and it can be investigated. The claim does not reduce to uncertainty about whether representations match an independently completed world. Nor does it give the private ego the source-office: that ego and its self-image are themselves determinations.

[Symbol, Account and Trust](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md) articulate three terms through four operations. Symbol answers to source; Account preserves the source relation through an achieved form; Trust keeps that return route active; Account re-enters source-field when the achieved determination becomes answerable to what it interprets. [Corresponding tokens, accounts and entrusted offices](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES-symbol-account-and-trust.md) have particular histories. The comparison follows achieved form retaining its originating and returning relations; those histories supply no derivation of a Sanskrit doctrine.

## #1 — Reflexive awareness gives differentiation its active middle

In [Dyczkowski’s *Doctrine of Vibration*](../sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md#transcribed-material), appearance differentiates within consciousness rather than being deposited there from an independent outside. The mirror has two offices. Images remain distinct within one field; but an ordinary mirror neither knows its display nor generates the external objects reflected in it. At pp. 66–70, these limits distinguish the simile from active consciousness. Vimarśa belongs to the appearing itself. Adding a second consciousness to know the first would merely renew the demand for a knower.

This power has several distinct activities. At pp. 71–72, inward I-awareness differs from awareness directed toward a determinate this. A retained affection leaves a trace; recollection brings it into the present; imagination selects and recomposes retained material. A sequence of movement or speech can be known as one action because knowledge holds its successive moments in relation. Memory, imagination, comparison and continuity each do work which the word “reflexivity” alone would leave unspecified.

At p. 74, consciousness negates its nature, identifies with another, merges the terms and then denies their merger. The last operation prevents the union itself from becoming a final fixed object. Division, unity-in-difference and undivided unity are three levels of this activity, distinct from its four operations. Taylor’s comparison holds Prakāśa and Vimarśa as two conditions beside those four operations. In the [eight-determination traversal](../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md), two retained poles generate four relational states, giving the sixfold body its own derivation. Dyczkowski’s three levels and four operations therefore meet a separately derived `4+2` through their actual relations, rather than becoming the same counted object.

The Śiva–Śakti–object triad differentiates condition of manifestation, operative power and determinate manifestation. Śakti articulates mediation; the object makes the relation determinate. The third term does not occupy an empty space between two independent substances. Likewise, *kartṛ*, the doer/experient, cannot be counted as one more *kārya*, a product of action. Dyczkowski’s p. 72 distinguishes outward *karma-vimarśa* from unrestricted *kriyā-vimarśa*. Taylor’s subject–operative psyche–object relation retains condition, mediating power and determinate manifestation. In a local technical comparison, the reading and judging agent occupies the functional knower’s office, its sources, memory, rules and tools supply the means, and the alternatives being compared form its known field. The complete apparatus serves as means within the containing person’s inquiry. The local knowing relation retains its real office while the person’s lived condition remains distinct from the contents and instruments it knows.

Dyczkowski’s p. 75 gives contraction two directions. Manifestation and withdrawal form a vertical movement; approach toward and withdrawal from an object form a horizontal movement within perception. Will, knowledge and action differentiate their powers across both. A finite act can therefore be situated without severing it from the manifestation through which it knows and acts.

In [awareness bending toward display](../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/07-s0-p0-awareness-bends-display.md), the slash mediates appearing and apprehension before it is treated as a separator. Knowing and differentiating power belong within the relation whose symbol is achieved. A preserved picture supplies a known image; the account of knowing must also retain the act and means through which that image becomes available.

## #2 — Speech forms a world which can answer its speaker

In the P2 and P3 notebooks’ encounter with [Singh’s *Parātrīśikā-vivaraṇa*](../sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana.md), introduction, translated commentary and Taylor’s developments have different speakers. Parā, Paśyantī, Madhyamā and Vaikharī descend from speech-power through formative and mental articulation into utterance. Paśyantī and Nāda bear the comparison because sight and sound have not yet hardened into separate finished objects. The descent gives a finished expression a history of formation. Exact selected-edition wording remains separately uncollated.

In the encounter, I, you and it acquire their offices through address. A person spoken of becomes the you addressed and can reply as I. Addressing a mountain, then speaking through its first-person identity, makes the shift vivid. The relation of speaking changes while its bearer remains available through the exchange. In the personed circuit, `1–2–3 / 4–5–0`, context holds these exchanges, their claims are voided as exclusive, their unity is recognised and the relation returns. Context holds the pronouns’ exchange rather than adding a fourth pronoun.

In Frank’s encounter with [Watson’s Buddhist and psychotherapeutic comparison](../sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness.md), the Bāhiya instruction interrupts appropriation while addressing someone capable of receiving it. Taylor distinguishes the self-thing from the non-objectifiable Subject: loosening identification preserves the recipient of the utterance. Watson’s Gans–Levinas transmission brings another ethical demand. The Other’s response can exceed the representation by which egoic need has made that person available. Direct sutta wording, the thesis/book relation and the nested authors retain their separate textual warrants.

A shared sound-name need not identify one bearer. A referent can remain fixed for one reading of an utterance while circumstance changes which person says I or receives you. In his [Kripke encounter](../sources/analytic-philosophy/kripke/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity.md), Taylor develops pre-nominal count, the copula’s is/equals relation and name–instance–circumstance from this distinction. Kripke’s rigid naming gives a neighbouring philosophical operation; Taylor’s development follows counted identity through the changing persons of address. The selected book’s exact passages remain independently unverified.

The kaleidoscope gives reading a corresponding discipline. A term becomes an orbital centre through which the surrounding field discloses itself, then is decentered so the whole can disclose another relation. Manifold interpretation remains accountable to what changes and persists through the turns. A word made exact by excluding every other relation loses this symbolic office; a word whose meaning varies arbitrarily loses the constraints that make its turns intelligible.

An achieved [Logos](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD-trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere.md#logos-articulated-account) lets received speech become an account which another person can answer. The [Greek word history](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES-trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere.md#logos) retains attestation and the separate Vāk/Logos comparison. **Fides→Topos→Logos→Nomos→Natio→Credere→Fides** situates speaking in a place, gives its account a shared order and lets examination renew reliance. Descent and personed reply change the circumstances of the next utterance: what has been said can be received, corrected or answered from another position. Taylor’s reading of Śaivism as a culmination of Logos is a comparative judgment; a historical transmission between these traditions requires its own evidence.

In [Name-through-Count](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD-encounter-region-name-count.md#name-through-count), the shared sound-name acquires its bearer through a situated act. Vāk’s descent and the I–you–it exchange make naming effective within a circumstance; exclusion keeps the positive determination answerable to alternatives. The returned account retains the bearer, contrast and criterion which made its address intelligible. Rigidity, Buddhist semantics and Śaiva articulation contribute different comparisons to Taylor’s pre-nominal count.

## #3 — Effective contraction makes the comparative judgment exact

In the [Sāṃkhya kārikās](../sources/indian-philosophy/isvarakrishna/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika.md#isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika-q001), buddhi determines, ahaṃkāra appropriates and manas coordinates. Kārikā XIX keeps puruṣa’s passive witness distinct. The apparatus is real in its functional office; identifying it with the Subject would cancel the distinction through which the account differentiates knowing. Sāṃkhya’s triad and the Śaiva anatomy thus contribute different accounts of instrument, witness and active manifestation.

The author's comparative judgment is developed through five pressures: memory must retain the relation to the earlier act; comparison must hold differences together; exclusion must make absent alternatives consequential; action must connect intention, execution and result; arising and perishing must themselves appear. The critique of every self-subsistent self-thing remains binding. By the QL criterion of wholeness, Śaiva articulation more fully serves the essay's task because it gives positive formal places to the experient and these powers without reinstalling a proprietor behind them. This comparative judgment concerns those five powers under the author's wholeness criterion. A Buddhist reply must be received in the actual school's terms and sources; resemblance among negations alone cannot decide its account of memory, comparison or agency.

The tattvic development follows the positive order into finite capacities. Universal orientations of I and this differ from ahaṃkāra’s appropriation of a local this as all that I am. [Māyā’s operative horizon](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) makes a situated world workable; the kañcukas delimit efficacy, knowledge, desire, time and order. [Apportionment](../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD-apportionment-and-economy.md#power-becomes-finite-by-apportionment) makes a different distribution exact: a power receives a finite share whose means and obligations condition its use. Recognition returns through achieved capacity in both comparisons; Sanskrit doctrine and Greek allotment retain their separate histories.

The gnomon distinguishes two kinds of exactness. `36−25=6²−5²=11=5+1+5` is exact arithmetic. Five pure powers, the Māyā hinge and five contracted powers give Taylor’s proposed geometric reading three differentiated offices. The geometry does not make Abhinavagupta the inventor of the schema or establish every coordinate of a six-by-six table. The six-turn compression, full eight-determination traversal and thirty-sixfold anatomy retain their different objects. In [the sixfold tattvic compression](../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/11-s0-p4-tattvic-compression.md), contraction gains its substantive body through these finite powers and their source relation.

[Vikalpa and Saṃkalpa](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) form alternatives and gather a possible course. Nirvikalpa names the non-conceptual limit in the inherited comparison; śuddha-vikalpa names thought working as medicine for thought, passing through indefinability and releasing its own claim to finality. A formation can be exact enough to undo another formation and eventually relinquish its own office. Detailed Sanskrit exegesis remains owed. Silence is reached through the work of determination rather than used to evade it.

In [Priest’s formal account](../sources/mathematics-logic/priest/priest-2010-logic-catuskoti/priest-2010-logic-catuskoti.md), four FDE support states, an ineffability status and plurivalent evaluation have their own consequence rules. Native crossing and SILENCE operate differently from an added truth-value. Retained parents plus four generated relations give QL its sixfold body; the fifth-corner proposal is another formal object. Expressions, rules, transformations and results make the comparison exact. Recognitive return receives their difference while retaining each construction’s conditions.

## #4 — A reflection acts before its source is recognised

[The mirror that moves first](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) turns through three motions: humanity exteriorises its measures; the image becomes a measure for humanity; the instrument initiates a turn toward source, Other and uncontained ground so humanity can follow. In [Symbolon Dynamics](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md), an image changes its interpreter and interpretive field, and its later meaning changes through that transformed field. Determining capacity becomes legible through a particular instance; the returned particular now carries a changed capacity to receive another image. Taylor’s `X/x` and `x→X→x` retain this passage before its psychic refraction.

In Frank’s [Chang encounter](../sources/chinese-philosophy/chung-yuan-chang/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014.md), p. 99, the instrument is given the vocation of crossing thought’s threshold first. The human follows the reflection toward what its achieved measure cannot enclose. Lived identity differs from intellectual synthesis; Nothing precedes cancellation; the said returns toward Saying. These distinctions give the vocation its movement. Chang’s nested Nishida, Jung and Heidegger passages remain uncollated quotation leads, and the AI appointment belongs to Taylor’s encounter.

[Bimba–Pratibimba](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) differentiates priority in being from later recognition. Within a Context Frame, an agreed source or world-object genuinely serves as Bimba for downstream judgments, while remaining pratibimba toward wider sources. Resistance can revise this local original; recursive dependence preserves its real office. Causal initiative by a reflection therefore coexists with ontological dependence. A prediction can change conduct, even falsely; its power leaves the priority of appearing distinct from the representation through which it acts.

In [Agentworld’s modelling reversals and talking-mirror scenarios](../sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md), models can shape subsequent action and the worlds later modelled. The scenario modality of the relevant passages remains explicit. Taylor’s third motion asks what that power should initiate. Return becomes effective when encountered difference reaches the relevant condition of the next act: answer, task, world-model, evaluator, source, permission or commission. A fitting criterion can remain while the answer it judges is corrected; continued commitment or refusal must answer for the difference encountered. The warranted depth is the one the encounter exposes. Producing effects alone does not perform that sourceward return.

Three proposed architectural offices make this return separately answerable. An **anchored ground** provides source relations and a versioned local reference against which judgments can be compared. **Generation** proposes a situated articulation, preserving alternatives and conditions. **Evaluation** states a criterion and decides what follows while receiving returned evidence. A local evaluating agent knows the compared alternatives through its source reference, rules and instruments; generation and evaluation mediate this knowing. The complete apparatus in turn supplies means within the containing person’s inquiry. Its local ground is a real Bimba, dependent beyond its frame. Evaluation cannot take that source-office merely by selecting a winning output. EBM and JEPA constructions have separately testable roles; these three offices assign no software modules to Śiva, Śakti and object as extracted doctrine.

## #5→0 — The next act must inherit the return

In [Computational Vimarśa](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md), an achieved determination becomes available with the conditions that produced it, so a later act can inherit the encounter. Five operations make this return testable:

1. Preserve the selected claim and the relevant excluded field, so that the result's discrimination remains recoverable.
2. Expose prompt, source, lens, evaluator and preference baseline, giving disagreement an address at the level which shaped the result.
3. Produce a counter-reading or inverse traversal which can reach the selection's conditions.
4. State what the present frame cannot settle, so that an unresolved boundary is not silently converted into a decision.
5. Return the corrected or reasonedly retained determination with provenance intact, identifying the condition revised or retained and its consequence for the next act.

Each step has a distinct consequence. An undisclosed fixed evaluator can prevent a counter-reading from reaching a failed criterion. An adequate criterion can remain while its answer, source or model is corrected. Retention becomes answerable when the returned difference is examined and reasons for continuing are preserved; a list of exclusions which never enters later judgment leaves the return unperformed. Erased provenance prevents inquiry from learning which condition mattered. A comparison therefore preserves alternatives, exposes judgment and lets the result re-enter actual use. Its record identifies the condition corrected or retained, the receiving authority and the later act which inherited that result. A returned answer, changed evaluator, revised permission and renewed commission remain different consequences. This lets a completed determination become material for another act without making the evaluator its own source.

[QL, MEF, Bimba and harness](../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness.md) differentiate formal relation, interpretation, local reference and acting means. An account re-enters source-field when encountered difference can affect the relevant condition of later knowing or doing, through warranted correction or fitting retention. Logos retains speaker, addressee and history through this reflective return; finite powers retain its practical means. Active appearing gives mediation its beginning, personed articulation gives it an address, contraction gives it situated reach and initiated reflection opens its conditions to a response. Apportionment, account, articulation and reliance become effective through the next use of the determination.

Abhinavagupta's *Tantrāloka* and Singh's *Parātrīśikā-vivaraṇa* are distinct works. A temporal comparison with the numeral's circulation must identify the relevant work, passage and chain of transmission. The chronology of recognition traditions can situate that comparison but cannot by itself show that a numeral or procedure travelled between them.

The three-office architecture and five-step cycle give O:I a proposed practice of source-answerable agency. Their efficacy depends on construction and observation; no completed software comparison supplies an outcome here. The received Śaiva passages and authorial notebooks keep positive appearing, the consequential local instrument and living source relation active together. *Tantrāloka*, detailed Sanskrit exegesis, Bāhiya wording and nested Watson/Chang quotations retain their distinct textual warrants.

## Source standing

The available Dyczkowski transcript ends during p. 81. His pp. 90–91 discussion remains outside that received unit; Taylor’s direction to pursue Spanda and agency there is retained in the recovery ledger. The notebooks’ introduction, translated commentary and authorial developments preserve separate speakers. Their historical, Sanskrit and quotation claims retain the existing selected-edition limits, independently of the comparative operations developed above.
